KEYBIND_CYCLE: Siren: next tone (hold for the manual siren while it is off)
ADMIN_TAB_SIRENS_DESC: How emergency vehicles sound: tones, airhorn, firetrucks and ambulances.
ADMIN_C_GENERAL_DESC: Emergency vehicles (class 18) get the siren keys: lights, siren, tone, airhorn; every player near hears them.
ADMIN_H_DISTANT: Silences GTA's far away police sirens that play on their own.
ADMIN_F_STOP_EXIT: Siren stops when the driver gets out
ADMIN_H_STOP_EXIT: On: leaving the driver seat turns the siren sound off (the lights stay).
ADMIN_H_FIRE_MODELS: These keep their own wail on tone 1, their airhorn and tone 3 are the fire truck sounds.
ADMIN_H_POWERCALL: Tone 1 of these models plays the ambulance powercall.
ADMIN_C_TONES_DESC: The game sounds of the three siren tones for normal emergency vehicles.
ADMIN_TAB_LIGHTBARS_DESC: ONX lightbars attached from a tuning slot, and the ONX siren tones.
ADMIN_C_LIGHTBARS_DESC: Needs the ONX lightbar models streamed (emergency-b-lightbars); each player's game draws its own copy, nothing spawns on the network.
ADMIN_H_LIGHTBAR_MOD: The vehicle mod slot that picks the lightbar (49 in the ONX pack).
ADMIN_H_ONX_MODELS: These always use the ONX tones; vehicles with an ONX lightbar use them anyway.
ADMIN_H_LIGHTBAR_MODELS: Which lightbar model each value of the tuning slot attaches.
ADMIN_C_ONX_TONES_DESC: The siren tones of vehicles with an ONX lightbar or listed above.
